inputs.text: Health workers may have concerns, but taking them to the streets at Unity Fountain in Maitama should not give unions a veto over national policy. The National Assembly has a duty to weigh the proposed reform bills in the national interest, putting patients and the country’s long-term welfare above organized pressure. A strained health sector needs responsible reform; preserving the status quo just because powerful groups resist change serves neither patients nor the country.
